MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 19

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 8

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
